input.sql: SELECT SOC, DOC, EdOpsCode, StatusType, FundingType, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY SOC, DOC, EdOpsCode, StatusType, FundingType ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 30

part.text: SOC=66 is the school ownership code. Let me verify the join and get the top 5 FRPM schools.

input.sql: SELECT s.SOC, f."School Name", f."FRPM Count (K-12)", f."Enrollment (K-12)", ROUND(CAST(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS REAL)/f."Enrollment (K-12)", 6) AS rate FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.SOC = '66' ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT f."School Name", ROUND(CAST(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS REAL)/f."Enrollment (K-12)", 6) AS frpm_rate FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.SOC = '66' ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 5
